On the now-landed, post-v1.23 tree measured by this plan: native COLD=1166 / WARM=998; native_nodevtools COLD=1166 / WARM=998 (both envs agree, as they did pre-landing). The new third env, native_pinmap_provisional (added by Plan 124-08), measures COLD=138 / WARM=0 -- a different cold/warm ratio than the two pinned envs because it compiles only 1 suite (vs 17), so its warm re-run's auto-regenerated Unity test-runner recompile touches none of the redefinition-prone shim files that the two pinned envs' warm re-runs still touch. Mechanism behind the +638 (warm) / +710 (cold) increase from pre-landing to post-landing on the two pinned envs: the landed include/rurp_platform_compat.h now defines the program-memory macros (pgm_read_ptr, strncpy_P, strncmp_P, sprintf_P, strcmp_P, sprintf_P, strncmp_P, PGM_P, F -- six new names beyond BASE-01's original eight, contributed by 780a3fb), and ArduinoFake's own pgmspace.h then redefines every one of them across roughly 27 more translation units than before. This is benign, identical-purpose redefinition -- not damage -- but it is not zero, and check_build_warnings.py cannot tell the difference between a benign redefinition and a real new warning class; it can only count. All three total_watermark/macro_redefinition figures recorded in warnings.native below are therefore the COLD figure for that env, per the mechanical reason stated in warnings.note. meta.flash_ceiling_move_260820_a7w: WHY: this quick task made both flash-limit guards report the ATmega328P / ATmega328PB / ATmega32U4's real 32768 B flash size, in place of the bootloader-reduced ceilings this file recorded before (uno 32256, uno328pb 32384, leonardo 28672). Requested and reaffirmed by the operator after being told the consequence in plain terms. WHAT WAS TRADED AWAY, per target: uno forfeits 512 B (optiboot), uno328pb forfeits 384 B (the urclock bootloader the MiniCore builder was subtracting), leonardo forfeits 4096 B (Caterina). The linker no longer protects any of those three regions -- on leonardo specifically, firmware that grows past the old 28672 B ceiling will now be linked into and flashed over Caterina, the USB bootloader, which this file's old figures made structurally impossible. No compensating guard was added; this is documentation of an accepted trade, not a new gate. CONCRETE EXPRESSION: leonardo's flash_free moved from 1460 B to 5556 B -- that entire 4096 B increase is Caterina's forfeited region now counted as usable headroom, not new flash. BOTH RECORDED BASELINES MOVED: scripts/baseline/size_baseline_base01.json's own flash_total figures move to 32768 in the same quick task (its own meta records the two-axis reasoning), by operator ruling, so that `--policy merge05` keeps comparing a live log against a baseline that agrees on board identity instead of reporting `board or framework moved` on every future real run. MERGE-05's growth axis is untouched by either edit: flash_used is byte-identical here and in BASE-01 (uno 25130/24824, uno328pb 25180/24874, leonardo 27212/26906), and none of the five MERGE-05 band/exemption literals in scripts/check_size_baseline.py moved.
